## Summary

What changes and why. Link the issue if there is one.

## Kind of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New component or prop
- [ ] Change to an existing component's behavior or look
- [ ] Tokens, theme or styles
- [ ] Docs, tooling, CI

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint` and `bun run build` pass
- [ ] Works on desktop and on a phone-sized, touch-first layout
- [ ] Follows the existing design language (componentize and polish; no redesigns)
- [ ] New or changed props are documented in the component's doc comment
- [ ] Screenshots or a recording for anything visual (before and after)

## Notes for review

Tradeoffs, assumptions, anything left for later.
